payload.summary: Problem statement confirmed. Option B: design+build. All 3 tasks scored. sampled_state+oracle_all_states modes. stage_snapshot_metrics() added to sampled_backtest.py. Parallel sampled_runtime key in task_calibration_diagnostics.

Sampled runtime emits no per-event scores today - confirmed from code. Gold cycle assembles the manifest but never calls backtest_sampled_runtime(). Infrastructure already exists in sampled_backtest.py. Design: (1) extend sampled_backtest.py with stage_snapshot_metrics() to score all 3 tasks (quali/race_start/race) per event; (2) add gold-cycle runner step after manifest assembly calling backtest_sampled_runtime for sampled_state and oracle_all_states modes; (3) route results into task_calibration_diagnostics as parallel sampled_runtime key; (4) update schema doc and add tests.
